description: Land Acquisition - Kongaswala and Barandana Mawathagma  D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, containing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilake), the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The document falls under "PART III - LANDS" and contains the characteristic elements of land gazettes including property descriptions, boundaries, and acquisition notices.
